core_research_thesis: Designing a high-performance battery requires a deep understanding of electrochemical principles and the interplay between materials science, electrical engineering, and chemical engineering
proven_facts: The Nernst Equation relates electrode potential to concentration
The Butler-Volmer Equation describes electrode kinetics
Fick's Laws of Diffusion govern mass transport in electrolytes
Ohm's Law relates voltage, current, and resistance
critical_unanswered_unknowns: Optimal electrode material composition for high energy density
Effect of electrolyte additives on cell performance and safety
Long-term durability of battery cells under various operating conditions

proposed_testable_hypotheses.ElectrodeMaterialOptimization: Cyclic voltammetry and galvanostatic charge-discharge testing
proposed_testable_hypotheses.ElectrolyteAdditiveEffect: Electrochemical impedance spectroscopy and accelerated life testing
proposed_testable_hypotheses.CellDurability: Accelerated life testing and post-mortem analysis

failure_modes_and_risks: Electrode material degradation and capacity fade
